assertion: An event exists, described as "Drought worsens in Europe".
judge_quote: Drought conditions have worsened across Central and Western Europe since the start of the summer
evidence_cited: Drought conditions have worsened across Central and Western Europe since the start of the summer with southern England, northern Italy and parts of Central Europe among the hardest-hit areas, according to the Global Drought Observatory.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Drought alert in Europe".
judge_quote: About half of Europe’s land area is experiencing drought with 9 percent reaching the alert level
evidence_cited: About half of Europe’s land area is experiencing drought with 9 percent reaching the alert level, including southern Germany, Hungary, Romania, Austria, the Czech Republic and Slovakia, according to the Combined Drought Indicator for mid-July.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Rivers reach record lows".
judge_quote: the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre said the Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels
evidence_cited: On Wednesday, the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre said the Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels after continued hotter and drier conditions.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Satellite imagery analysis".
judge_quote: Al Jazeera’s Open Source Unit analysed satellite imagery showing signs of worsening drought
evidence_cited: Al Jazeera’s Open Source Unit analysed satellite imagery showing signs of worsening drought, including retreating water in major rivers, declining soil moisture and the yellowing of green spaces in several cities.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Loire channel changes".
judge_quote: A time-series comparison of satellite images of the Loire River near the French city of Saumur shows a clear change in the shape of the river channel during August from 2023 to 2026
evidence_cited: A time-series comparison of satellite images of the Loire River near the French city of Saumur shows a clear change in the shape of the river channel during August from 2023 to 2026.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Garonne area vegetation browning".
judge_quote: Near Moissac in southwestern France, a satellite comparison from May 21 to August 1 shows a considerable change in the colour of farm areas and vegetation surrounding the Garonne River
evidence_cited: Near Moissac in southwestern France, a satellite comparison from May 21 to August 1 shows a considerable change in the colour of farm areas and vegetation surrounding the Garonne River.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Early Garonne intervention".
judge_quote: In early July, the Garonne River management authority began an early operation to support river levels, describing it as the earliest such intervention since the system was introduced in 1993
evidence_cited: In early July, the Garonne River management authority began an early operation to support river levels, describing it as the earliest such intervention since the system was introduced in 1993 after river flows near Toulouse approached record-low levels for that time of year.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Rhine channel exposure".
judge_quote: In Germany, comparisons of satellite images taken near Kaub show an expansion of exposed sandy and gravelly areas within the Rhine River channel from May 1 to July 29
evidence_cited: In Germany, comparisons of satellite images taken near Kaub show an expansion of exposed sandy and gravelly areas within the Rhine River channel from May 1 to July 29.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Rhine shipping halted".
judge_quote: falling water levels had reached unprecedented levels and brought shipping traffic to a halt at a bottleneck on the river
evidence_cited: On Wednesday, the Reuters news agency reported that falling water levels had reached unprecedented levels and brought shipping traffic to a halt at a bottleneck on the river with some vessels becoming stranded.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Navigation warning on Rhine".
judge_quote: Earlier, Germany’s inland waterway transport sector warned that the severe decline near Kaub could make commercial and tourist navigation impossible on parts of the river
evidence_cited: Earlier, Germany’s inland waterway transport sector warned that the severe decline near Kaub could make commercial and tourist navigation impossible on parts of the river.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Po River level changes".
judge_quote: In Italy, images of the Po River near Boretto in the Emilia-Romagna region show changes in the extent of water and exposed areas during August in 2023 and 2026
evidence_cited: In Italy, images of the Po River near Boretto in the Emilia-Romagna region show changes in the extent of water and exposed areas during August in 2023 and 2026.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Po basin hydrological stress".
judge_quote: This coincides with the Joint Research Centre’s report that the Po basin is experiencing severe hydrological stress
evidence_cited: This coincides with the Joint Research Centre’s report that the Po basin is experiencing severe hydrological stress while parts of Italy are facing pressure on water use for irrigation and energy production.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Danube water level decline".
judge_quote: The impact of falling water levels is also visible on the Danube, which has experienced declines along several sections in Hungary and Romania
evidence_cited: The impact of falling water levels is also visible on the Danube, which has experienced declines along several sections in Hungary and Romania.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Danube navigation pressure".
judge_quote: The Joint Research Centre said reduced Danube flows are putting pressure on navigation, water supplies and agricultural activity
evidence_cited: The Joint Research Centre said reduced Danube flows are putting pressure on navigation, water supplies and agricultural activity as well as the energy sector.

assertion: An event exists, described as "London vegetation decline".
judge_quote: In England, satellite imagery captured visible changes across large areas of London, including Hyde Park, and the area around Stonehenge, where vegetation vitality has declined significantly
evidence_cited: In England, satellite imagery captured visible changes across large areas of London, including Hyde Park, and the area around Stonehenge, where vegetation vitality has declined significantly.

assertion: An event exists, described as "England's driest July".
judge_quote: England recorded just 6.5mm (a quarter of an inch) of rainfall in July, ... making it the driest July since records began in 1836
evidence_cited: England recorded just 6.5mm (a quarter of an inch) of rainfall in July, equivalent to 10 percent of the long-term average, making it the driest July since records began in 1836.

assertion: An event exists, described as "England drought declared".
judge_quote: the United Kingdom’s Environment Agency announced that 71.3 percent of England was officially in drought
evidence_cited: On Tuesday, the United Kingdom’s Environment Agency announced that 71.3 percent of England was officially in drought, including all areas of Greater London, while reservoir storage had fallen to 69 percent.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Vienna park degradation".
judge_quote: Satellite images of parks in the Austrian capital, Vienna, show changes in grass colour and water availability and the effects of extreme heat
evidence_cited: Satellite images of parks in the Austrian capital, Vienna, show changes in grass colour and water availability and the effects of extreme heat.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Dry conditions to continue".
judge_quote: European monitoring centres expect dry conditions to continue through September
evidence_cited: European monitoring centres expect dry conditions to continue through September.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Auer-Welsbach Park change".
judge_quote: High-resolution satellite imagery from SkySat shows a striking visual change in the vitality of vegetation at Auer-Welsbach Park in Vienna between the summers of 2025 and 2026
evidence_cited: High-resolution satellite imagery from SkySat shows a striking visual change in the vitality of vegetation at Auer-Welsbach Park in Vienna between the summers of 2025 and 2026.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Urban green spaces deteriorate".
judge_quote: This visual decline documents the arrival of water and heat stress at the heart of European cities where extreme temperatures and a lack of rainfall have caused soil to dry out and public green spaces to deteriorate in Britain, Austria and other parts of Central Europe
evidence_cited: This visual decline documents the arrival of water and heat stress at the heart of European cities where extreme temperatures and a lack of rainfall have caused soil to dry out and public green spaces to deteriorate in Britain, Austria and other parts of Central Europe.
